From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Acme pilot: stakeholder map & procurement steps

Hi Jordan / Priya — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery + agreed next steps so we're all aligned.

Key stakeholders (from call)
- Economic buyer: Priya Shah (VP Product) — owns budget and final approval.
- Technical lead: Jordan Ellis — will run the pilot evaluations (latency, throughput).
- Security: TBD (Priya to introduce).
- Procurement: Procurement team (Priya to confirm contact and timeline).

Decision criteria we heard
- Performance: end-to-end latency for chat flows; consistent 95th percentile.
- Cost: unit cost per 1k tokens for production vs pilot economics.
- Reliability/SLA: pilot needs high availability and clear SLOs.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 evidence and a filled security questionnaire.

Procurement path
- Acme prefers PO + standard T&Cs. Procurement typically requires: SOC 2 report, completed security questionnaire (attached), and an executed MSA.
- Timeline estimate from call: ~3–4 weeks once legal/procurement have what they need.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Marissa: send draft SOW and pilot pricing (attached SOW_v1.docx) — today.
- Priya: share security contact and any additional procurement constraints — by EOD Thu 4/8.
- Jordan: confirm acceptance criteria for pilot (latency targets, sample prompts) — by Mon 4/12.

Note on exceptions: if procurement needs longer than your pilot start date (you mentioned targeting Apr 25), we may request a procurement exception (discounts / payment terms / SLA tweaks) internally to accelerate onboarding. I'll loop in Sales Ops & Finance for any exception requests.

Attachments: SOW_v1.docx, ACME_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Acme pilot: stakeholder map & procurement steps

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A couple clarifications from procurement/security side:

- Security: I'll attach the security questionnaire I mentioned (ACME_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). We need a SOC 2 Type II report or auditor contact; can you provide that?
- Procurement timeline: once we have SOC 2 + completed questionnaire + proposed SOW/MSA, procurement estimates ~3–4 weeks to issue a PO. That would push the start date to mid-May unless we expedite.
- Payment terms: our standard is net-60 for pilot contracts, but willing to discuss.
- SLA: we require 99.9% availability for production; for pilots we accept slightly lower but need clear fallbacks.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) share SOC 2 evidence; 2) accept net-60 for pilot or if you need an exception; 3) provide a simple SLA for the pilot with credits?

Jordan — I'll intro you to our security lead (cc'd once I have contact).

Best,
Priya

Marissa — thanks for the context. Quick responses below: 

1) Discount: I can approve up to 15% off list for a pilot (one-time, non-recurring) provided the deal is limited to the pilot scope and Finance signs off on the write-off. Please annotate the HubSpot deal with the reason (pilot acceleration).

2) Payment terms: Net-60 is outside standard Sales Ops tolerance for new accounts. I can approve net-45 for the pilot as a compromise, conditioned on: signed exception form, procurement PO within 60 days, and credit checks passed. Net-60 would need CFO approval (I can escalate if you think it's necessary).

3) SLA: We can commit to a 99.9% availability SLA for pilot with standard service credits (pro-rated credit tiers). Any additional uptime guarantees or financial penalties require Legal sign-off and are limited to production contracts.

4) Security/SOC2: I'll ask Security to share the SOC 2 contact; in parallel, we can provide a redacted SOC 2 report and an attestation letter. Security review must clear before exceptions are finalized.

Next steps for Marissa:
- Fill and return Redwood_Procurement_Exception_Form.pdf (attach here)
- Update HubSpot deal: DEAL-ACME-2027-04 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567)
- I will loop Legal if they request net-60 or expanded SLA obligations.
